artboards.title: B · Where the figures come from

annotations.text:
PRIMARY USER  Clinic owner, once a month.
PRIMARY JOB  Find out whether this month's payroll is done, and start it if not.
PRIMARY CTA  Run payroll.

DELIBERATELY HIDDEN
Rate tables, verification state, pay components, snapshot mechanics, the exception catalogue, every technical banner.

AVAILABLE BY DRILL-DOWN
View details on the safety line · a finished period's payslips and history · employee setup.

PRIMARY USER  Clinic owner or HR admin.
PRIMARY JOB  Confirm who is being paid, and catch anybody who cannot be.
PRIMARY CTA  Continue to attendance.

DELIBERATELY HIDDEN
Employment type internals, legal-employer ids, why the engine excluded somebody.

AVAILABLE BY DRILL-DOWN
Open an employee's record · add somebody to the run · see why the locum is out.

PRIMARY USER  Clinic owner or HR admin.
PRIMARY JOB  See what people actually worked, and clear anything waiting on a manager.
PRIMARY CTA  Continue to earnings.

DELIBERATELY HIDDEN
Attendance record ids, punch-level rows, the ORP formula.

AVAILABLE BY DRILL-DOWN
Open the timesheet · approve overtime · open one person's month.

PRIMARY USER  Clinic owner or HR admin.
PRIMARY JOB  Check what each person earns, and add anything the system could not know.
PRIMARY CTA  Continue to deductions.

DELIBERATELY HIDDEN
Component codes, liability flags, proration basis, the ORP hourly rate derivation.

AVAILABLE BY DRILL-DOWN
Expand a person for every line and its origin · add an allowance · bulk-add for several people.

PRIMARY USER  Clinic owner or HR admin.
PRIMARY JOB  Enter monthly tax, and see what else comes off pay.
PRIMARY CTA  Continue to review.

DELIBERATELY HIDDEN
Statutory band tables, age-rule internals, EPF/SOCSO/EIS employer-side split.

AVAILABLE BY DRILL-DOWN
Per-person statutory breakdown · record an advance repayment · the age-60 explanation.

PRIMARY USER  Clinic OWNER. This is the screen the redesign is really for.
PRIMARY JOB  Decide whether this month's payroll is right, and resolve whatever is not.
PRIMARY CTA  Continue to approve — blocked until the must-fix items are cleared.

DELIBERATELY HIDDEN
Severity taxonomy, override semantics, variance thresholds, exception codes.

AVAILABLE BY DRILL-DOWN
Full breakdown per person · compare with last month · each Fix opens the right screen inline.

PRIMARY USER  Clinic owner, or a second approver where maker/checker is on.
PRIMARY JOB  Understand exactly what is being signed off, and what happens next.
PRIMARY CTA  Finalise September payroll.

DELIBERATELY HIDDEN
Snapshot version numbers and hashes, the approval-gate object, audit rows.

AVAILABLE BY DRILL-DOWN
History timeline · what is still outstanding on statutory setup · maker/checker settings.

PRIMARY USER  HR admin, and the owner when somebody asks a question about their pay.
PRIMARY JOB  Answer anything about one person without opening five screens.
PRIMARY CTA  Complete setup — the readiness checklist is the call to action.

DELIBERATELY HIDDEN
Effective-dated database rows, profile-vs-salary-table duality, permission internals.

AVAILABLE BY DRILL-DOWN
Eight tabs: employment, salary, attendance, leave, claims, payroll, documents.

PRIMARY USER  HR admin or owner.
PRIMARY JOB  See what somebody is paid now, what they will be paid, and what they were paid before.
PRIMARY CTA  Record salary change.

DELIBERATELY HIDDEN
Effective-from/effective-to row mechanics; the reader sees periods, not rows.

AVAILABLE BY DRILL-DOWN
Full history with reason and author · overtime and unpaid-leave day rates · bank account.

PRIMARY USER  Accountant, or a Kuwick specialist, at go-live. Almost never the owner.
PRIMARY JOB  Get the clinic to the point where monthly payroll is boring.
PRIMARY CTA  Continue the setup checklist — currently step 5, checking the statutory rates.

DELIBERATELY HIDDEN
Nothing. This is where the complexity is allowed to live.

AVAILABLE BY DRILL-DOWN
The full 16 × 12 component liability matrix · per-employer statutory readiness · rate verification.

PRIMARY USER  Clinic owner reviewing away from a desk.
PRIMARY JOB  Everything the desktop review does — this is full processing, not a cut-down view.
PRIMARY CTA  Continue to approve.

DELIBERATELY HIDDEN
The person-by-person grid loses its per-component columns; the totals and the variance stay.

AVAILABLE BY DRILL-DOWN
Tap a person for the full breakdown · each Fix opens the same inline flow as desktop.

PRIMARY USER  Clinic owner between patients, on a phone.
PRIMARY JOB  Know where payroll stands, clear a blocker, look somebody up, sanity-check the totals.
PRIMARY CTA  Run payroll · Enter PCB · Complete setup · (Finalise stays locked).

DELIBERATELY HIDDEN
No desktop grid is shrunk. Earnings and deductions per component are desktop and tablet work.

AVAILABLE BY DRILL-DOWN
Every card opens the same screen the desktop uses. Approval is deliberately possible only where the numbers are legible.

PRIMARY USER  The owner, reviewing this proposal.
PRIMARY JOB  Decide whether daily work and configuration are split in the right place.
PRIMARY CTA  Approve the IA, or move an item between the two columns.

DELIBERATELY HIDDEN
—

AVAILABLE BY DRILL-DOWN
Every item that leaves the daily nav is listed with where it goes and why.

PRIMARY USER  The owner, reviewing this proposal.
PRIMARY JOB  See where Kuwick beats a generic payroll product, and confirm nothing is duplicated.
PRIMARY CTA  Approve the connections, or name one that is wrong.

DELIBERATELY HIDDEN
—

AVAILABLE BY DRILL-DOWN
Five chains, each ending in payroll or finance.
